tools.name: search_passages
tools.description: Search the selected screenplay for a prop or event. Use short names or phrases to find evidence before drawing a conclusion. Returns up to five verbatim passages with scene identifiers and indicative page numbers. No matches does not prove that an explanation is absent.

query.description: Prop name, alias or event to search for in the screenplay's language; whitespace alone is invalid.

scene_ids.description: Restrict the search to these existing scene identifiers; omit or use null to search the whole selected screenplay.

top_k.description: Maximum number of ranked passages to return.

tools.name: check_continuity
tools.description: Check prop continuity across one to twelve explicitly selected scenes using the extraction and comparison pipeline. Use for a requested scan or to investigate a suspect transition. Returns candidate alerts with source passages and analysis limitations; it does not confirm or dismiss alerts. This read operation consumes model quota and cannot establish consistency outside its scene selection.

scene_ids.description: Existing scene identifiers to analyse; include both sides of a suspect transition and relevant intervening scenes. The host restores screenplay order.

tools.name: create_revision_draft
tools.description: Generate and save a separate revision draft for one scene when the user requests a correction. Preserve the scene heading, language and unrelated content. Returns a draft identifier and proposed text for review, or explains why no draft was created. It never applies a correction, overwrites the screenplay or changes review decisions; applying the draft requires human approval.

scene_id.description: Identifier of the single existing scene to revise.

instruction.description: Specific continuity correction requested by the user; keep the edit minimal and unrelated content unchanged.

example_arguments.instruction: Keep Runa's brass pocket watch broken and stopped. Change only its action description; preserve all other text.
